# Mailroom-ML: appendix {.page-title}

[Verification notes · 30 October 2026]{.kicker}

Checked against `LLM-Mailroom-Services/mailroom-ml` `01c2272` on 30 October 2026.

## Current run

M9c is `eval_m9c-20261014-113614`. Document-type accuracy 0.9598 (310/323). Conditional subclass accuracy 0.7387 (229/310), short of 0.75. Window ECE 0.0189. Out-of-distribution flags 5.57% (18/323). The 0.3901 acceptance figure is a confidence-only upper bound at threshold 0.94, not a production fast-path rate.

M9b remains in the case study as history: 0.9505 document-type accuracy, ECE 0.0152, and a 74.3% fast path at 0.97.

## Tests and serving

493 line-start `def test_` functions in 33 `test_*.py` files. Primary serving is ONNX on CPU. The Modal serve app is a fallback. The weights are [mailroom-modernbert-classifier](https://huggingface.co/Lucius-Morningstar/mailroom-modernbert-classifier).

## Figures

The published figures are the earlier Arm B captures. Source main's `reports/charts/` has m9a-local runs and no Arm B, M9b or M9c chart directory, so they were not re-plotted from M9c.

:::
